message:
style(seo): colour the prerendered stat tiles and shorten the footer line

- stats become three colour-coded tiles (price / demand / stability) instead of
  a flat table, using the same palette as the catalog cards
- adds a 7-day change chip (green up / red down) computed from price history
- footer credit shortened to a coloured 'Цены обновляются ежедневно' line and
  the third-party source name dropped from the rendered page
author: BSS Index Developer
